def _bm(mask):
    m = np.asarray(mask)
    return (m[:, :, 0] if m.ndim == 3 else m).astype(bool)


def _w(mask, _depth, _K, _E):
    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
    z = np.asarray(_depth)[ys, xs].astype(np.float64).reshape(-1)
    ok = z > 0
    ys, xs, z = ys[ok], xs[ok], z[ok]
    pc = np.stack([(xs - _K[0, 2]) * z / _K[0, 0], (ys - _K[1, 2]) * z / _K[1, 1], z], axis=-1)
    return (_E @ np.hstack([pc, np.ones((len(pc), 1))]).T).T[:, :3]


def _top(pts, band=0.004):
    zref = float(np.percentile(pts[:, 2], 95))
    t = pts[np.abs(pts[:, 2] - zref) <= band]
    return t if len(t) >= 10 else pts


def _stack_place(red_mask, green_mask, grasp_pos, _depth, _K, _E):
    """Where the fingers must go so the red cube's base sits on the green top."""
    g = _bm(green_mask)

    rt = _top(_w(_ero(r, iterations=2), _depth, _K, _E))

    ring = _dil(r, iterations=25) & ~_dil(r | g, iterations=8)
    zr = _w(ring, _depth, _K, _E)[:, 2]
